title: POST /v1/call-artifact-imports request body (as-built)
description: SAME-HOST-ONLY: source_path is resolved on the API server's local filesystem (Path(...).expanduser().resolve()); external gateways cannot use this endpoint to push artifacts. This transport is deprecated for external gateways - see the proposed multipart upload endpoint in contracts/gateway-v1.yaml. organization_id and project_id are required unless call_id points at an existing call that carries them.

source_path.description: Local filesystem path (file or directory) on the API host. Must exist.

call_id.description: Attach artifacts to an existing call instead of creating an imported call.

provider_call_id.description: Defaults to a content-hash id (artifact-import-...); used for idempotency.
